$comment: PulsarScript built-in and host-call registry (SPEC §8). Single source of truth: the Go VM embeds this file and the TypeScript compiler, analyzer and interpreter import it. provider: core = pure, implemented by every runtime; host = supplied by the embedding host. Parameter types: any, number, string, boolean, array, object, or a union such as string|number. A parameter may be optional (only trailing) or variadic (only last). capability names the permission a host call requires (decision A4); hosts enforce it per call.

functions.name: typeOf
functions.doc: Type name: nil, number, string, boolean, array or object.

functions.name: string
functions.doc: Printed form of a value (§3.2).

functions.name: number
functions.doc: Numbers as-is; true/false to 1/0; a decimal-literal string to its number; anything else to nil.

functions.name: concat
functions.doc: Joins the printed forms of all arguments.

functions.name: len
functions.doc: Length of a string in Unicode code points, or of an array.

functions.name: abs
functions.doc: Absolute value.

functions.name: floor
functions.doc: Largest integer not greater than n.

functions.name: ceil
functions.doc: Smallest integer not less than n.

functions.name: round
functions.doc: Nearest integer; halves round up (toward +Infinity), as in JavaScript.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.doc: Square root; NaN for negative n.

functions.name: pow
functions.doc: base raised to exponent.

functions.name: min
functions.doc: Smaller of a and b.

functions.name: max
functions.doc: Larger of a and b.

functions.name: clamp
functions.doc: min(max(n, lo), hi).

functions.name: isInteger
functions.doc: True for a number with no fractional part.

functions.name: isFinite
functions.doc: True for a number that is not NaN or ±Infinity.

functions.name: sin
functions.doc: Sine of n in radians.

functions.name: cos
functions.doc: Cosine of n in radians.

functions.name: tan
functions.doc: Tangent of n in radians.

functions.name: atan2
functions.doc: Two-argument arctangent of y/x in radians.

functions.name: log
functions.doc: Natural logarithm of n.

functions.name: log10
functions.doc: Base-10 logarithm of n.

functions.name: exp
functions.doc: Euler's number e raised to the power n.

functions.name: mathPi
functions.doc: The ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter (pi).

functions.name: mathE
functions.doc: Euler's number (e).

functions.name: toUpper
functions.doc: Upper case (Unicode simple case mapping).

functions.name: toLower
functions.doc: Lower case (Unicode simple case mapping).

functions.name: trim
functions.doc: Removes leading and trailing whitespace.

functions.name: indexOf
functions.doc: Code-point index of the first occurrence of sub at or after start (default 0), or -1.

functions.name: lastIndexOf
functions.doc: Code-point index of the last occurrence of sub at or before start (default end), or -1.

functions.name: split
functions.doc: Splits s by sep (or into code points when sep is empty).

functions.name: replace
functions.doc: Replaces all non-overlapping occurrences of target with replacement.

functions.name: startsWith
functions.doc: Whether s begins with prefix.

functions.name: endsWith
functions.doc: Whether s ends with suffix.

functions.name: repeat
functions.doc: Concatenates count copies of s (count truncated toward zero; non-negative).

functions.name: padStart
functions.doc: Pads the start of s with fill (default space) up to length code points.

functions.name: padEnd
functions.doc: Pads the end of s with fill (default space) up to length code points.

functions.name: charCodeAt
functions.doc: Unicode code point at code-point index, or nil if out of range.

functions.name: fromCharCode
functions.doc: Single-character string for Unicode scalar value code.

functions.name: substr
functions.doc: Up to length code points from start (both truncated toward zero; negative values are errors).

functions.name: parseInt
functions.doc: Whole string as an integer in base 2-36 (optional sign, surrounding whitespace); nil if any character is not a digit of the base.

functions.name: parseFloat
functions.doc: Whole string as a decimal number with optional exponent; nil otherwise.

functions.name: toNumberOr
functions.doc: number(value), or fallback when that is nil.

functions.name: clock
functions.doc: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

functions.name: dateFormat
functions.doc: Formats epoch milliseconds in UTC (default YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ).

functions.name: dateParse
functions.doc: Parses an ISO-8601 UTC/offset date string into epoch milliseconds, or nil.

functions.name: random
functions.doc: Pseudo-random number in [0, 1).

functions.name: randomInt
functions.doc: Pseudo-random integer in [min(a, b), max(a, b)], bounds truncated toward zero.

functions.name: randomSeed
functions.doc: Seeds random and randomInt so a run is repeatable on the same runtime.

functions.name: arrayLen
functions.doc: Number of elements.

functions.name: arrayPush
functions.doc: New array with values appended.

functions.name: arrayPop
functions.doc: Last element, or nil when empty. Does not change a.

functions.name: arraySlice
functions.doc: Elements from start up to end (exclusive); indices truncated and clamped; start > end gives [].

functions.name: arrayConcat
functions.doc: New array joining all arguments.

functions.name: arrayIndexOf
functions.doc: Index of the first element == value, or -1.

functions.name: arrayJoin
functions.doc: Joins printed elements using sep (default ",").

functions.name: arrayIncludes
functions.doc: Whether any element == value.

functions.name: arrayMap
functions.doc: New array containing fn(el) for each element.

functions.name: arrayFilter
functions.doc: New array of elements for which fn(el) is truthy.

functions.name: arrayReduce
functions.doc: Reduces elements left-to-right starting at initial via fn(acc, el).

functions.name: arrayFind
functions.doc: First element for which fn(el) is truthy, or nil.

functions.name: arraySort
functions.doc: New stably sorted array (numeric/code-point order by default, or cmp(a, b) returning negative/zero/positive).

functions.name: objKeys
functions.doc: Keys in sorted order.

functions.name: objValues
functions.doc: Values in sorted key order.

functions.name: objHas
functions.doc: Whether string(key) is a key of o.

functions.name: objGet
functions.doc: Value at string(key), or nil.

functions.name: objSet
functions.doc: New object with string(key) set to value.

functions.name: objDelete
functions.doc: New object without string(key).

functions.name: objEntries
functions.doc: Array of [key, value] pairs in sorted key order.

functions.name: objMerge
functions.doc: New object merging keys left-to-right; later values overwrite earlier ones.

functions.name: jsonParse
functions.doc: Parses JSON text into PulsarScript values (null maps to nil; max depth 64).

functions.name: jsonStringify
functions.doc: Formats a value as JSON with sorted keys (max depth 64; rejects non-finite numbers and functions).

functions.name: registerHandler
functions.doc: Exposes a top-level function by name or function/closure value to the host under name.

functions.name: on
functions.doc: Registers a function listener for named host/script events.

functions.name: emit
functions.doc: Emits an event {name, payload} to the host or event queue.

functions.name: sleep
functions.doc: Suspends execution for at least ms milliseconds.

functions.name: yield
functions.doc: Yields control back to the host scheduler.

functions.name: kvGet
functions.doc: Value stored under key, or nil.

functions.name: kvSet
functions.doc: Stores value under key.

functions.name: kvDelete
functions.doc: Removes key.

functions.name: fsRead
functions.doc: Contents of the file at path as text, or nil when it does not exist.

functions.name: fsList
functions.doc: Entries of the folder at path: objects {name, dir, size, modified}.

functions.name: fsStat
functions.doc: {name, dir, size, modified} for path, or nil when it does not exist.

functions.name: fsExists
functions.doc: Whether path exists.

functions.name: fsWrite
functions.doc: Writes string(content) to path, creating missing folders.

functions.name: fsDelete
functions.doc: Deletes the file or folder (with its contents) at path.

functions.name: fsMkdir
functions.doc: Creates the folder at path and any missing parents.

functions.name: fsRename
functions.doc: Renames or moves a file or folder.

functions.name: fsCopy
functions.doc: Copies a file or folder (recursively) to a new path.

functions.name: fsQuota
functions.doc: {used, max} in bytes for the user's storage.

functions.name: fsReadBase64
functions.doc: Contents of the file at path as Base64, for binary files; nil when it does not exist.

functions.name: fsWriteBase64
functions.doc: Writes Base64-decoded data to path, for binary files.

functions.name: emitEvent
functions.doc: Sends an event to the host.

functions.name: pollEvent
functions.doc: Next queued event, or nil.

functions.name: notifyWindow
functions.doc: Sends payload to the app's open windows as an SDK script.event (progress, results of a service).

functions.name: ipcSetContext
functions.doc: Sets the device and process used by ipcSend.

functions.name: ipcSend
functions.doc: Sends a PulsarOS IPC message; subject to the app's allowed channels and operations.
